name: One real turn toward native AI appointment or five-turn establishment; resumable

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.enemyLast; if a=='ERROR_ASSIGN' or a=='UNKNOWN_ASSIGN' then error('enemy ASSIGN was not judged: '..a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_ASSIGN' or a=='REJECTED_ASSIGN' or a=='WAITING_NATIVE_ASSIGN' or a=='ALREADY_NATIVE_ASSIGNED' or a=='ASSIGN_ALREADY_ATTEMPTED' or a=='NATIVE_ASSIGN_UNAVAILABLE'

local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local c=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG'); local a=b.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='UNKNOWN_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='REJECTED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' then error('enemy native confirmation refused: '..a) end; if a=='QUEUED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='DISPATCHED_CONFIRM_ENEMY' or a=='BARRIER_SENT_CONFIRM_ENEMY' then return false end; return not c.cityID or a=='ACCEPTED_CONFIRM_ENEMY'

steps.code: local c=Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_CONFIG'); if not c.cityID then return 'WAITING_NATIVE' end; return ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.EnemyProgress()
